int_name: LASALLE UNIVERSITY DWY & W OLNEY AVE

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features continuous sidewalks and a marked bike lane, but lacks visible crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals at the signalized intersection. The presence of institutional buildings suggests a need for more robust crossing infrastructure to manage potential pedestrian-vehicle conflicts.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at a signalized intersection increases the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area near the traffic light

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian signal heads to guide safe crossing times.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals with countdown timers to improve pedestrian predictability and safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a signalized intersection. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and bike lanes are present, the long crossing distance lacks a pedestrian refuge island and dedicated pedestrian signals are not visible.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which may lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and a sidewalk in an institutional setting. While basic infrastructure is present, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the wide driveway entrance create potential conflict points.

hazards.name: Wide driveway entrance
hazards.description: The wide, uncurbed entrance to the parking area allows vehicles to make high-speed turns across the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the foreground, where the sidewalk meets the driveway.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from vegetation
hazards.description: Bushes at the corner may obstruct sight lines between drivers exiting the driveway and pedestrians on the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, between the sidewalk and the driveway.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way and timing information.

interventions.title: Curb Radius Reduction
interventions.description: Tighten the curb radius at the driveway entrance to slow down turning vehicles and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The environment features a well-maintained sidewalk on one side of a wide, multi-lane roadway, but lacks any marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The wide, straight geometry of the road likely encourages higher vehicle speeds, creating a significant barrier for pedestrians wishing to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no marked crosswalk or signage for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, straight lanes may encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing risk for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the distance

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility (continental) marked crosswalk to designate a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install warning signs or RRFBs to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.
